rebaseline_note: SV-CORPUS-GRAD.3.7 (2026-07-24, PGEN-SV-CORPUS-GRAD-0022, release 1.0.172->1.0.173, schema 18 UNCHANGED): restoring the digit-suffixed drive/charge strength keywords (IEEE 1800-2017 A.8.6 / section-28.11). The strength rule and net_type/drive_strength referenced BARE tokens (/supply\b/, /strong\b/, /pull\b/, /weak\b/, /highz\b/) that cannot match the real keywords supply0/1, strong0/1, pull0/1, weak0/1, highz0/1 (no word boundary between a letter and a trailing digit), so drive_strength/net_strength/pull*_strength were entirely DEAD - ledger SV-0043. Fix = 10 new digit-suffixed tokens + LRM-faithful strength0/strength1 rules + 6-combo drive_strength (opposite-digit only, so (strong1,strong1) correctly rejects) + net_type supply0/supply1 + pull*_strength, minus the 3 orphaned bare tokens; UNGATED (drive strength & supply nets are IEEE 1364-2005 constructs too, so cross-profile). Census net +8 (1469->1477). All 8 net new symbols POSITIVELY WITNESSED by generated drive-strength/supply-net samples: total 1346->1354 (+8), canonical witness 1329->1337 (+8), union witness 1340->1348 (+8); UNKNOWN unchanged (canonical 11 / union 0, residual []), still fully_certified_via_union=true, deterministic seeds 0/7/42, sample_parse_failures=0. Purely additive (the strength machinery was 100% unparseable before). Prior note (SV-CORPUS-GRAD.3.6, release 1.0.172) retained in git history.
done_rule: SV is recognized fully_certified when the multi-config certificate-coverage union UNKNOWN reaches 0. Until then the recognized fully_certified-accounting basis is the sound multi-config union (expected_union_unknown), whose residual rule set must equal expected_union_residual_rules exactly (order-insensitive) and be deterministic (byte-identical) across all declared seeds, with sample_parse_failures=0; the canonical single-config accounting (expected_canonical_unknown) is recorded alongside. The union is sound by construction: a rule is credited only when some config POSITIVELY covers it (a proof or a witness — including the VERILOG-2005-PROFILE.6.7 per-profile ProfileEntryUnreachable/ProfileUnproducibleGate proofs, each independently re-derived), never merely because a profile leaves the rule out of its universe.
